semiconductor_relevance: High — Permag provides critical magnetic solutions and rare earth materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Permag is a global leader in magnetic solutions, specializing in precision magnetic assemblies and rare earth materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. They are the only North American producer of Samarium Cobalt magnets and a trusted supplier of DFARS-compliant Neodymium Iron Boron, ensuring secure and regulation-aligned solutions for mission-critical applications.

regional_presence.United States: Permag operates a vertically integrated manufacturing facility in the U.S., ensuring quality and compliance with local regulations.
